title: Semio Js Entity Class Refactor
description: Refactor semio/client/lib/js to only have one class per entity with exactly one method per field, one method for command, and one method for events for every field change. Align with semio/rs and graphql schema. Update downstream semio/react and tests.
summary: Completed semio/js entity kit refactor for remaining design list nodes and Quality benchmarks. Layer and Group now use installEntityKitMethods with readDesignListNodeField helpers and per-field on*Changed subscriptions. Quality.benchmarks() is declarative via parseBenchmarkConnectionUnder with coarseEvent. All prior kit entities (Kit, Design, Type, Piece, Connection, Port, Connector, Tag, Concept, Quality scalars, Representation, node entities) already use the factory pattern. Typecheck (bunx tsc --noEmit) and embedded vitest (3 tests) pass.
